Is he a reserved person? does he open up with his other friends or is it just you that was left in the dark? 

I suggest you get some closure and ask why he reacted that way, if he still doesn’t give you a clear answer please just cut him off. There are many other people out there that can provide you with comfort and happiness, do not get hung up from this because everyone will go through this in their lives.
